messages.subject: Welcome to the Revolution R Open group!
parts:
Welcome! This is the group for Revolution R Open users. If you have any questions about how Revolution R Open works, or any suggestions for future improvements, this is the place. Staff from Revolution Analytics follow this list, and feel free to also contribute to the discussion yourself!

In case you haven't visited yet, the main site for information about Revolution R Open is http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/

Enjoy!
